body:
**Note rendering** · explored 2026-09-30, decided 2026-10-01 · **Implemented**

**Decision: C's typography, placed anywhere — F and G.**

- **Free notes** are type set on the canvas: a thin rule and the text, no paper. Click with the note tool for a default note, or drag out the size you want. Double-click (or select and press Enter) to edit; drag a handle to resize. Trash on hover; Delete or Backspace when selected.
- **Attached notes** sit inline on their node as a marker, over the content — never moved aside. Hover opens the note; a click keeps it open.
- **Comment bubbles** work the same way: hover to read, click to keep it open, Delete to remove a local thread.
- **Undo** covers creating, editing, moving, resizing and deleting notes — and only the person's own changes. A step an agent has changed since is refused, not overwritten.

**Not doing:** status pills (B, D) — another state to keep up to date · C's margin footnotes · A's sticky paper · E's frame captions.
